purpose: Diagnose allocation correctness, candidate economics, forecast error, risk mismatch and cost assumptions without selecting a winner
registration_status: new retrospective diagnostic study on previously examined discovery histories; not preregistered untouched evidence
v1: Preserve the original class, policies, identities and artifacts; repeat all 9 original comparisons to verify financial and decision-byte equivalence
v2: Explicit opt-in policy version 2: score and return feasible risk-scaled coefficients; actual prior coefficients; feasible no-trade candidate; bounded deterministic simplex search for nonsmooth objective

v2_solver.scope: risk-cap surface and feasible exact prior; not full joint optimization of cash and mix

corrected_comparisons: same 3 policies x same 3 original cost scenarios, 9 V2 comparisons; no tuned risk/cost/window parameters
frozen_target_cost_controls: 3 original base target schedules x gross/base/double costs; no reoptimization, 9 diagnostic replays
risk_controls: 3 original base target schedules x common 5% annual prior-covariance ceiling, base costs; quarterly, prior 120 months, never lever up; 3 diagnostic replays
risk_interpretation: same prior risk ceiling is not equal realized risk; separate exact risk/Sharpe mean identity is arithmetic, not causal
hindsight_controls: 2 full-sample fixed-mix V2 comparators at base costs (maximum and median); use full1996-2020 information and original 10% ceiling; nondeployable, not a mathematical upper bound
forecast_audit: Separate prior raw and half-shrunk monthly mean/covariance forecasts from following-quarter realized gross factor P&L; compare RMSE against zero mean; never compare shrunk per-period objective directly with ordinary realized annual Sharpe
pool_audit: all 5 factors, 5 fixed five-year periods, marginal 12-month-block mean intervals, contribution and concentration; no factor discarded or replaced after results
solver_audit: known synthetic false-cash and two-asset median-miss controls; per-decision bounded-lattice coverage and local-vs-lattice objective gaps; absence of a grid improvement is not global proof

interpretation_rules.implementation: known-answer failure is a code/objective defect, regardless of historical returns; old studies remain preserved
interpretation_rules.solver: a higher feasible lattice score establishes a search miss; a clean lattice audit is limited to its declared candidate coverage
interpretation_rules.costs: differences along one frozen target schedule isolate declared mechanical proxy charges, not observed execution costs
interpretation_rules.risk: weaker ranking under the common prior ceiling is consistent with unequal risk and/or overlay timing/cost effects; no isolated causal contribution or causal percentage from algebra alone
interpretation_rules.forecast: training mean forecast RMSE no better than zero supports weak mean-timing evidence in this sample, not a theorem of zero predictability
interpretation_rules.pool: published methods and positive averages do not establish stable executable premiums; current-vintage, gross-exposure and cost qualifications remain blockers
interpretation_rules.promotion: no automatic winner, deployment, formal admission, holdout opening or tuning from diagnostic results
